en.24:42: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day on which your Lord will come.
en.24:43: But understand this: If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.
en.24:44: For this reason, you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.
en.24:45: Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of his household, to give the others their food at the proper time?
en.24:46: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
en.24:47: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
en.24:48: But suppose that servant is wicked and says in his heart, ‘My master will be away a long time.’
en.24:49: And he begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.
en.24:50: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate.
en.24:51: Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

en.13:33: Be on your guard and stay alert! For you do not know when the appointed time will come.
en.13:34: It is like a man going on a journey who left his house, put each servant in charge of his own task, and instructed the doorkeeper to keep watch.
en.13:35: Therefore keep watch, because you do not know when the master of the house will return—whether in the evening, at midnight, when the rooster crows, or in the morning.
en.13:36: Otherwise, he may arrive without notice and find you sleeping.
en.13:37: And what I say to you, I say to everyone: Keep watch!”

en.12:35: Be dressed for service and keep your lamps burning.
en.12:36: Then you will be like servants waiting for their master to return from the wedding banquet, so that when he comes and knocks, they can open the door for him at once.
en.12:37: Blessed are those servants whom the master finds on watch when he returns. Truly I tell you, he will dress himself to serve and will have them recline at the table, and he himself will come and wait on them.
en.12:38: Even if he comes in the second or third watch of the night and finds them alert, those servants will be blessed.
en.12:39: But understand this: If the homeowner had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.
en.12:40: You also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect.”
en.12:41: “Lord,” said Peter, “are You addressing this parable to us, or to everyone else as well?”
en.12:42: And the Lord answered, “Who then is the faithful and wise manager, whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their portion at the proper time?
en.12:43: Blessed is that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
en.12:44: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
en.12:45: But suppose that servant says in his heart, ‘My master will be a long time in coming,’ and he begins to beat the menservants and maidservants, and to eat and drink and get drunk.
en.12:46: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate. Then he will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the unbelievers.
en.12:47: That servant who knows his master’s will but does not get ready or follow his instructions will be beaten with many blows.
en.12:48: But the one who unknowingly does things worthy of punishment will be beaten with few blows. From everyone who has been given much, much will be required; and from him who has been entrusted with much, even more will be demanded.
en.21:34: But watch yourselves, or your hearts will be weighed down by dissipation, drunkenness, and the worries of life—and that day will spring upon you suddenly like a snare.
en.21:35: For it will come upon all who dwell on the face of all the earth.
en.21:36: So keep watch at all times, and pray that you may have the strength to escape all that is about to happen and to stand before the Son of Man.”
